    int to, capacity, flow, rev;
    Edge() {}
    Edge(int t, int c, int f, int r) : to(t), capacity(c), flow(f), rev(r) {}
};

const int MAX = 121;
vector<Edge> graph[MAX];
int dist[MAX], ptr[MAX], source, sink, nodes;
queue<int> q;

void add_edge(int v, int u, int cap) {
    graph[v].push_back(Edge(u, cap, 0, (int)graph[u].size()));
    graph[u].push_back(Edge(v, 0, 0, (int)graph[v].size() - 1));
}

bool build_level_graph() {
    for (int i = 0; i <= sink; ++i) dist[i] = 1e9;
    dist[source] = 0;
    q = queue<int>();
    q.push(source);
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int v = q.front(); q.pop();
        for (auto &e : graph[v]) {
            int to = e.to, residual = e.capacity - e.flow;
            if (dist[to] == 1e9 && residual > 0) {
                dist[to] = dist[v] + 1;
                q.push(to);
            }
        }
    }
    return dist[sink] != 1e9;
}

int send_flow(int v, int flow) {
    if (v == sink) return flow;
    for (int &i = ptr[v]; i < (int)graph[v].size(); ++i) {
        auto &e = graph[v][i];
        int to = e.to, residual = e.capacity - e.flow;
        if (dist[to] == dist[v] + 1 && residual > 0) {
            int pushed = send_flow(to, min(flow, residual));
            if (pushed > 0) {
                e.flow += pushed;
                graph[to][e.rev].flow -= pushed;
                return pushed;
            }
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

int max_flow() {
    int total = 0;
    while (build_level_graph()) {
        for (int i = 0; i <= sink; ++i) ptr[i] = 0;
        int pushed;
        while ((pushed = send_flow(source, 1e9)) > 0) {
            total += pushed;
        }
    }
    return total;
}

    int n, tbad;
    cin >> n >> tbad;
    char grid[N][N], grid_b[N][N];
    int px, py;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            cin >> grid[i][j];
            if (grid[i][j] == 'Z') px = i, py = j;
        }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
            cin >> grid_b[i][j];

    source = 0;
    sink = 2 * n * n + 1;

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            int u = i * n + j + 1;
            if (grid[i][j] != '0') add_edge(source, u, grid[i][j] - '0');
            if (grid_b[i][j] != '0') add_edge(u + n * n, sink, grid_b[i][j] - '0');
